title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale — Episode5 Streets Of Missed Encounters

meta.Event Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Line: One week later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: What?! You can't stay to watch me practice?! But you always do on your days off!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
Something came up and...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Something came up...?
Did someone ask you to help them again?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The manager of “VIOLET” collapsed... You know, the one on the corner?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh no! The manager collapsed...?!
Is he okay?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Luckily, he was taken to the hospital in a hurry, so he's fine now. However, there's an event starting there tomorrow and he asked us to help run things.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(But someone else can do that...
Daddy and his team don't actually have to go...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Like I said before, you should practice somewhere in town since everyone will be there to watch you.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Does that mean Daddy and the others are...?)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Um, Daddy...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: You and your team are always running around helping everyone in town while telling me to sing out on the street somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Is it because you really don't want to watch me practice...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you think that...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, we want to be with you as much as we can. That includes Nagi, Taiga and of course, myself. We all care about you very much.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And there's a reason why I've been telling you to sing on this street.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, I genuinely believe that singing around here will benefit you greatly.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Benefit me...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes. Nagi, Taiga and I were all able to grow as singers because of this town.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
In so many ways too...
And I'm sure you'll understand that in time, An.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
It's almost time for that meeting.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I promise to watch you practice next Sunday around noon...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I have some business to take care of in the morning, but I should be free afterward. Nagi and Taiga also said they'll be available too.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a promise.
But for now, I need to go.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay, good luck...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (There he goes...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Mommy's at work too...
I'm really all alone today...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (But Daddy said he and his team became good singers because they sang here...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I should go practice...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Hey, here for another morning practice...? Hm? What's wrong? You seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Huh?
Oh, no... There's nothing wrong!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Do I really sound that unhappy...?
That just means I need to try harder...)

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Hi, An!
You sound as good as ever today!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, hi...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
I don't sound good at all...
I can't even hit the high notes...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
What?
I don't think so! You're better than a lot of the grown-ups around here!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: That's not true...

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: An, is everything alright? You don't sound very happy today. Is your throat okay?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Oh, is it because your dad's been too busy to watch you practice...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Don't worry, An.
Once he has time, I'm sure... No, I'm absolutely certain that he'll come watch you practice.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(He's right...
He promised to watch me practice next Sunday...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (So, until then, I need to keep practicing...!)
Sunday

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I'm going now!!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Finally, it's Sunday...!
I get to practice with Daddy and everyone at noon!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Just two more hours until then...!
Alright, I'll start warming up!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Geez, that took forever...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: However, we finally landed ourselves a deal with an overseas label. It did take a while, but we're at last taking the next step.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Thank you for handling all the negotiations, Ken. We have so many goals that we just won't be able to accomplish with a major Japanese label.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And I want An to see the world too.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which, it's almost time!
We should go see An!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We were so busy this week that we couldn't help her at all, so let's teach her as much as we can today!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Right. She's been getting ready since this morning, so she might be all tuckered out...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Hey, Ken! You guys!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, it's the manager.
And you're the new hire, yes...?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Yes!
So, I apologize for what I'm about to ask...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it turns out the main guest we booked for today's event can't make it, so we could really use a hand...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Huh? Your main guest?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hang on. Today's event...?
Wasn't “WIRED” supposed to perform?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: WIRED? As in the really famous American group? How do you guys keep getting these big catches?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Well, the owner's actually a huge fan and asked them to perform...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Exactly. We prepared far in advance and even got other musicians to join after hearing the big news. However...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: They're having trouble getting past immigration and can't do much of anything right now. We don't even know if or when they'll be let through...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Normally, we'd have to cancel if our main guest bails on us, but in this case, people have traveled a long ways and even stayed the night in anticipation of this event...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: As for a team that can match WIRED and take their spot as the main guest...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Now I get it. And that's what brought you guys here.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yeah, in terms of other musicians who can match what WIRED can do...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The live house's reputation is on the line here...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Especially since people have arrived the day before to see this event.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We have to help, Nagi, Taiga...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Only we can fill the shoes that WIRED has left behind.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You're right.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it...!
If you'll come with me now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's fine, but I'll need to let An know first.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I can't get ahold of her...
She has been practicing since this morning...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Then, I'll go find her!
The rest of you can head to the live house with the manager!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, thanks.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Please tell An that I'm sorry and I promise to spend the entire day with her next time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She should be singing somewhere in the middle of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Understood!!
You can count on me!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, let's head over...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, An...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Where are Daddy and the others?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (He said that they'd be meeting with someone on another street, so I'll go take a look!)

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Hmm... An should be around here somewhere... But I don't see her anywhere... What should I do?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: No, she has to be somewhere on this street...! I have to find her fast...!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hmm... I don't see them.
They're supposed to be meeting somewhere around here, right?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: And they usually go down this path whenever they stop by to see me practice...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll wait here today since they always come from that way!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I hope they get here soon...
